fusions.name: Turret Round
fusions.desc: Fires one round from the gun mounted on your ride into the first enemy in its path. It deals 30 damage and ignores armour.

fusions.name: Drive-By Spray
fusions.desc: Sprays 3 shots at once, spread apart; each deals 3 damage. You move 10% faster for 2 seconds after.

fusions.name: Limbered Cannon
fusions.desc: Unhitches a cannon beside you for 15 seconds. It fires at enemies within 7 tiles and deals 6 damage every 1.5 seconds.

fusions.name: Backfiring Exhaust
fusions.desc: Each time you spend stamina, your engine backfires at the nearest enemy within 8 tiles; it deals 7 damage. Once every 4 seconds.
